props.name: acknowledged

props.name: connection

props.name: unread

props.name: draft

props.name: onRetryConnection

props.name: initials

props.name: label

props.name: categories

props.name: onReject

props.name: dismissLabel

props.description: The id of the element that describes the field, such as its help or error text.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name used when the value is submitted.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: The longest value the field accepts, in characters.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Supplied accessible names for the visibility toggle.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the toggle while the password is visible, such as "Hide password".

props.name: prompt
props.description: Supplied prompt text, for example "Photograph the data plate".

props.name: captureLabel
props.description: Supplied outcome-named label for the capture button.

props.name: requiredLabel
props.description: Supplied text shown when the photo is required (for example "Required"). Shown only when `required` is true.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether a photo must be attached. Shows the required marker.

props.name: captured
props.description: SUPPLIED references to photos already captured. The prompt renders them and owns no capture or upload session.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: The prompt shown before a photo is attached. Supplied text.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the control unavailable. It stays visible at reduced opacity.

props.name: onCaptureRequest
props.description: `capture-request`: the worker asked to capture.

props.name: onCaptureComplete
props.description: `capture-complete`: the device returned image files. They are handed upward untouched and are not stored here. The canvas (or a future CaptureSession surface) owns camera, upload and retry state (BRD 1.2 5.7.1 Feature 7).

props.name: value
props.description: SUPPLIED, named by what they measure. The ring draws the ratio; it never turns it into a derived status (BRD 1.2 5.9).

props.name: total
props.description: The whole the value is measured against. The ring draws the ratio and derives no status from it.

props.name: centeredLabel
props.description: The figure written in the CENTRE, supplied and short (for example "70%" or "7/10"). A ring without it forces the worker to estimate a proportion by eye, which introduces error into operational decisions (BRD 1.3 section 10.5).

props.name: textAlternative
props.description: Supplied plain-text equivalent, exposed to assistive technology.

props.name: size
props.description: 32px or 48px (BRD 1.3 section 10.3).

props.name: emptyExplanation
props.description: Supplied explanation when there is nothing to draw (no total). Never blank.

props.name: records
props.description: Rendered in the order SUPPLIED. A list never sorts or filters for correctness (BRD 1.2 5.6.1 Feature 2).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the list.

props.name: emptyTitle
props.description: A short statement that there are no records. SUPPLIED.

props.name: emptyExplanation
props.description: Why there are no records and what would cause some to appear. SUPPLIED. Never blank.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: When given, rows are buttons that emit `row-select`.

props.name: text
props.description: The heading text.

props.name: size
props.description: The heading size token. It never exceeds 28px.

props.name: level
props.description: Semantic level is independent of visual size.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Content placed at the end of the header, such as a status.

props.name: id
props.description: The element id, so the section it names can point at it.

props.name: id
props.description: id of the visible label, set by FormField. A placeholder is never the label.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name used when the value is submitted.

props.name: options
props.description: SUPPLIED. The select renders these options and fetches none. It never decides which options are valid: that is the source system's business (BRD 1.2 5.7.1 Feature 2C).

props.name: selection
props.description: Controlled: the composing layer owns the selection. `null` is "nothing chosen yet". Nothing is held as authoritative.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the value of the option the worker chose.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Supplied text for the unselected state, for example "Choose a failure condition". Shown as a disabled first option.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Supplied text shown instead of an empty list. Never blank.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the field unavailable. It stays visible at reduced opacity.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the value as failing validation, so the field shows its error treatment.

props.name: describedBy
props.description: The id of the element that describes the field, such as its help or error text.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Called when the field receives focus.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the field loses focus.

props.name: shape
props.description: The shape of the content that is on its way, from the design system table.

props.name: cardHeight
props.description: Cards have variable height. Ignored for every other shape.

props.name: shimmer
props.description: Whether the shimmer sweep runs. True by default. It never runs on an action button or a card frame, whatever is passed (BRD 1.3 section 8.3).

props.name: current
props.description: SUPPLIED, named by meaning. The marker reflects what it is given.

props.name: threshold
props.description: The point on the scale the marker sits at. Supplied; the component never decides whether it is breached.

props.name: minimum
props.description: The scale. Supplied: the indicator never derives its own bounds.

props.name: maximum
props.description: The end of the scale the current value is measured against.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Supplied text for the current value (for example "2h 10m remaining") and for the threshold marker (for example "SLA 4h").

props.name: thresholdLabel
props.description: The text for the threshold marker, so it is not shown by shape or colour alone.

props.name: title
props.description: The chart title, shown above the chart and used as its accessible name.

props.name: textAlternative
props.description: The key value in plain text. A worker who cannot read the chart for any reason must still be able to read the truth it shows.

props.name: status
props.description: The condition of the data as supplied: loading, ready or degraded. An empty series shows the empty explanation.

props.name: degradedMessage
props.description: Supplied when the data is partial. Never inferred from the data.

props.name: emptyTitle
props.description: The heading shown when the chart has no data. Supplied text.

props.name: emptyExplanation
props.description: Why the chart is empty and what would cause data to appear. Supplied text, never blank.

props.name: label
props.description: What the figure is, such as "Jobs today".

props.name: value
props.description: SUPPLIED. A tile renders a figure and never computes one (a count, a total, a percentage). An unknown figure is supplied as an em dash.

props.name: status
props.description: The shape beside the figure, SUPPLIED: a warning triangle or an error circle. Null shows none, including beside a zero. The tile never decides that a figure needs attention: that is upstream's judgment, and the shape plus the label carry it, never colour alone.

props.name: caption
props.description: A short supporting line under the figure. Supplied text.

props.name: tone
props.description: Emphasis chosen upstream. `attention` adds a warning border. The caption text carries the meaning.

props.name: state
props.description: The condition to show: success, warning, error, checkpoint, inactive or loading. Each has its own shape.

props.name: label
props.description: Plain-language accessible name, supplied by the caller. Never derived from a code.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hide from assistive technology when adjacent visible text already says the same thing.

props.name: size
props.description: The marker size: small, medium or large.

props.name: label
props.description: The status text, supplied. A pill renders a status; it never derives one from other data.

props.name: tone
props.description: The meaning the pill carries: success, warning, error, checkpoint or neutral. The label always says it in words too.

props.name: role
props.description: The structural role: workspace, card, panel or chrome. It decides the background.

props.name: children
props.description: The content placed on the surface.

props.name: as
props.description: The HTML element to render, so the surface carries the right landmark.

props.name: padding
props.description: Spacing token name, e.g. 4 means --space-4. Internal padding only; Surface applies no outer margin.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Cards separate from the cream workspace by border, not shadow (BRD 1.3 section 7).

props.name: className
props.description: An extra class for placing the surface in a layout. It must not change colours or elevation.

props.name: freshness
props.description: How current the shown data is: fresh, syncing or stale. Supplied, never worked out.

props.name: connectivity
props.description: The state of the connection: connected, reconnecting or disconnected. Kept apart from freshness.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible text beside the dot, supplied (for example "Synced").

props.name: items
props.description: Rendered as supplied (at most five).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the navigation landmark.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the destination id the worker chose. The canvas performs the navigation.

props.name: menuItemId
props.description: The item that opens a menu (More) reports it.

props.name: menuOpen
props.description: Whether the More menu is open, so the More item shows the right state.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled: the composing layer owns the value (and the draft). The field holds no authoritative copy.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the text as the worker types.

props.name: id
props.description: id of the visible label, set by FormField. Placeholder is never the label.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name used when the value is submitted.

props.name: rows
props.description: How many lines tall the field starts.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: The longest value the field accepts, in characters.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the field unavailable. It stays visible at reduced opacity.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the value as failing validation, so the field shows its error treatment.

props.name: describedBy
props.description: The id of the element that describes the field, such as its help or error text.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled: the composing layer owns the value. The input holds no authoritative copy (BRD 1.2 5.7).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the text as the worker types. The composing layer owns the value.

props.name: id
props.description: id of the visible label, set by FormField. Placeholder is never the label.

props.name: type
props.description: The native input type: text, email or password.

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: The browser autofill hint, such as "email" or "current-password".

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the field unavailable. It stays visible at reduced opacity.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the value as failing validation, so the field shows its error treatment.

props.name: describedBy
props.description: The id of the element that describes the field, such as its help or error text.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required for assistive technology and validation.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name used when the value is submitted.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Upper bound enforced by the browser as well as by validation.

props.name: inputMode
props.description: Which on-screen keyboard a phone shows: text, email, numeric or tel.

props.name: hardened
props.description: Identifiers and passwords must not be auto-capitalized, auto-corrected or spell-checked (and sent to a dictionary).

props.name: message
props.description: Supplied text. A toast never builds its message from a code.

props.name: tone
props.description: Success or info. The message always says it in words too.

props.name: durationMs
props.description: Default 7 seconds (BRD 1.2 5.8 Feature 8). The shell passes the configured value.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the dismiss control.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the toast should go, after its supplied duration or when the worker dismisses it.

props.name: widget
props.description: The widget exactly as delivered. It is validated here, never trusted.

props.name: headerLabel
props.description: The widget's own header text, supplied (for example "Olannah Insight").

props.name: fallbackTitle
props.description: Supplied worker-facing fallback text for anything that cannot be rendered. No schema, type or code.

props.name: fallbackMessage
props.description: What the worker sees when the payload is unsupported or invalid. Plain words, no version or type name.

props.name: onDiagnostic
props.description: Receives WHY a widget could not render, so unsupported (a version problem) and invalid (an upstream defect) stay distinguishable in diagnostics even though the worker sees the same fallback. Not an interaction event.

props.name: steps
props.description: Ordered steps, rendered in the order supplied. Empty renders nothing: the composing layer chooses an EmptyState.

props.name: activeStepId
props.description: SUPPLIED, never computed: which step is the current one.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the steps list.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: `step-select`: the worker asked to look at a step.

props.name: onAdvance
props.description: `step-advance`: the worker asked to move a step forward. The stepper advances and completes nothing itself: the canvas decides, and any write routes through the checkpoint (BRD 1.2 5.6 Prohibited).

props.name: initialContinuity
props.description: Presentation continuity (which step was open), handed in and out by the shell's persistence manager. This component is persistence-CAPABLE only: the shell decides whether it persists, and nothing here is workflow progress (BRD 1.2 5.4).

props.name: onContinuity
props.description: Called with the expanded step so the shell can restore it if the stepper is preserved across a layout change.
